name: Deco Masjid
summary: Five broad fan ribs rise over a pierced prayer hall, creating an architectural mosque with an Art Deco rhythm.
why: The roof spreads into a powerful geometric fan instead of an onion dome. Its ribs resolve into a strong horizontal hall with an open pointed entrance. A slender minaret anchors the unfamiliar roof in a recognizable mosque composition.
risk: The expressive roof feels like contemporary mosque architecture. It may read first as an architectural emblem rather than a traditional mosque.
reasonToChoose: You want a striking architectural mosque with a broad geometric silhouette.
